column1: # Default risk rules, from the guidebook's merge policy (p8).
# Anything matching no rule is yellow. Green must be earned by an explicit
# pattern, so an unfamiliar file can never auto-merge by being unrecognised.
# The highest tier any file reaches wins: risk does not average.

column4: CI can read every secret in the repository

column1: # Coarse backstop only. A real secret scanner belongs in the gate, where it
# blocks outright: a leaked credential is not a change someone should be
# able to approve. This exists so a project with no scanner is not at zero.

column4: a credential appears in the added lines

column1: # Was green until 2026-09-03, which is the tier that can auto-merge. Green
# on the one file that decides whether Felix is checking anything at all:
# `echo nonexistent > .felix` disables the floor for a whole checkout and
# would have merged itself. Every project seeded from this template gets
# the row that stops it instead.

column4: names which project governs this checkout, and every hook resolves through it

column1: # A directory name says where a file sits, never what it is. Unqualified, this

# auto-merge. The extension set is the row above's, so what this adds is only
# the location, which is what it was always meant to add.
